The image, weighing 647991705 bytes, was pulled at a low throughput of 2716924 bytes/s. This throughput is below the expected threshold of 5 MB/s, indicating a slow registry or network connection.

findings.statement: The total pod startup time was 240.0 seconds, significantly exceeding the SLO of 10.0 seconds.
The image pull phase was the dominant factor, lasting 238.502 seconds, which is 99% of the total startup time.

The image was pulled at a throughput of 2716924 bytes/s (approximately 2.7 MB/s).
The detected throughput of 2.7 MB/s is below the typical threshold of 5 MB/s for normal image pulls.
